The {wiki:Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits|Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits} are the ceremonial garments of the advisers of King {npc:Kesar the Younger}, in **Bounac**. The base outfit is earned by finishing the **Galthen and the Lost Queen** mission of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest|Adventures of Galthen Quest} (defeating {creature:Megasylvan Yselda}). The 1st addon is given by the carpenter {npc:John (Bounac)}, at night, but only if you keep Yselda's four Saplings alive during the fight. The 2nd addon is the final reward of {wiki:The Order of the Stag Quest|The Order of the Stag Quest}, on the Isle of Ada. With both addons you receive the achievement **King's Council**.

Almost everything in Bounac depends on the day/night cycle: it is **day** in Tibia between hh:15 and hh:45 (real time) and **night** between hh:45 and hh:15. {npc:Kesar the Younger} is only in the throne room during the day; {npc:John (Bounac)} only gives the addon at night; {creature:Night Harpy|Night Harpies} only appear at night.
Decide **before** the fight against Yselda whether you want the 1st addon: if a Sapling dies, you lose John's addon and the {item:Violet Tulip}. Go with a team of 5, with as many mages as possible.
Buy the soup ingredients on the Market if you do not want to hunt {creature:Dark Carnisylvan|Dark Carnisylvans}.
Night Harpy beaks **cannot** be bought: each character must skin their own 20 with the {item:Obsidian Knife}.
Take a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} to the Isle of Ada: the wiki does not describe how to get back from there.
Bounac is the secret fortress of the Order of the Lion, on an island between Thais and Meriana. You have already been there in the Order of the Lion Quest, which is mandatory for this quest.

Go to **Edron** and look for the small boat **north** of the mountain pass: that is where you travel to Bounac from. You can only enter at level **250** or higher. **How to return:** the wiki does not describe the return trip from Bounac to Edron; go back to where you landed and look for the return boat there. If you cannot find it, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (it takes you to your temple; it does not work in No-Logout Zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block).
Bounac depot (after the Order of the Lion)
Checking whether it is day or night

Bounac's NPCs move around depending on the Tibia time. {npc:Kesar the Younger} is in the **throne room during the day** and, at night, in his quarters **1 floor below**. It is day between **hh:15 and hh:45** (real time) and night between **hh:45 and hh:15**.
Go up to the throne room

Inside Bounac, go up to the **3rd floor** by the stairs where {npc:Onfroi} stands during the day, head **north** and then **west** to the {npc:Bounac Guard}. Say {key:hi}, {key:pass}, {key:yes} and go up another **2 floors**: you reach the throne room.
To leave the castle, go down to the floor below the throne room, follow the ramp **south** and enter the lift. Once you have used it, it also serves as a shortcut to come back up.
2. Base outfit: Galthen and the Lost Queen (investigation)

The base outfit is the reward for the mission *Galthen and the Lost Queen*, the first of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest|Adventures of Galthen Quest}. Queen Yselda, Kesar's wife, has disappeared and you will follow in the footsteps of the old knight Galthen.

During the day, in the throne room, say {key:hi} and {key:yselda} to {npc:Kesar the Younger}. When he asks what you know, answer anything. He tells you that his wife was taken from him and that the seer Lesh showed him her fate.

Go down to the town and look for {npc:Lesh the Seer}, **1 floor above** ground. Say {key:hi} and {key:yselda}. He tells you to follow the trail of the knight Galthen, who left Bounac for **Edron** to seek the mages' advice.

Go to **Edron** (return from Bounac: see the step *Travelling to Bounac*) and go up to the **Magic Academy**, where {npc:Spectulus} is. Say {key:hi}, {key:yselda} and {key:yes}. He explains the curse that turns women into trees and sends you to look for traces of Galthen in Bounac. Then return to Bounac by the small boat north of Edron's mountain pass.
Reading the notes in front of An Idol

In the **south** part of Bounac, walk **west** to a house where {npc:An Idol} is. Use the ritual notes lying on the floor in front of it. You receive the message: *"Staring at the writing you begin to decipher a letter. Then another and another. The symbols seem to wriggle and move: VBOX"*.
An Idol and the notes on the floor in front of it
Greet {npc:An Idol} by saying {key:VBOX} (it means 'Death' in Jekhr). You are teleported to a small cave.

Inside the cave keep walking **south** to a dead tree. Use it to receive {item:Galthen's Satchel}, with an {item:Artefact Box} and a {item:Parchment} inside (Galthen's old notes about the disappearance of a woman in Bounac). After a few seconds you are automatically teleported out of the cave.
The dead tree where Galthen's satchel is
Galthen's Satchel with Artefact Box and Parchment
You can take a new {item:Galthen's Satchel} from this tree every **30 days**.

**North-east** of An Idol is {npc:Innkeeper Alphonse}. Ask him about Galthen ({key:galthen}; in the dialogue recorded on the wiki the word {key:yselda} was used) and answer {key:yes} to all the questions (three times). At the end he gives you the old knight's {item:Ritual Notes}.
Go back to the throne room (during the day) and say {key:hi} and {key:yselda} to {npc:Kesar the Younger}. He gives you access to the **Bounacean Lion**, a sealed cave beneath the castle.
3. Forest of Life and Megasylvan Yselda (base outfit and 1st addon condition)
This fight decides the 1st addon: you only get it if the four Megasylvan Saplings survive until Yselda dies.

You need 20 {item:Carnisylvan Finger|Carnisylvan Fingers}, 10 {item:Carnisylvan Bark|Carnisylvan Barks} and 2 {item:Human Teeth}. All three drop from the {creature:Dark Carnisylvan|Dark Carnisylvans}, {creature:Poisonous Carnisylvan|Poisonous Carnisylvans} and {creature:Hulking Carnisylvan|Hulking Carnisylvans} in the Forest of Life itself (Human Teeth are rare), and all of them are sold on the **Market**.
If you buy them before going down, you skip the hunt and make the soup as soon as you arrive.

Go through the gate **1 floor below ground** to enter the **Bounacean Lion** dungeon. Go down the stairs, head **south-west** and go down again. To leave before reaching the Forest of Life, go back the same way.
The cave is full of {creature:Crypt Warrior|Crypt Warriors} (7,800 health each). The wiki recommends level **350** for the Bounacean Lion and the Forest of Life.
Go round the cave to the **Sulphur Pool** (floor -3). When you step into it you are teleported to the **Forest of Life**.
The Sulphur Pool that takes you to the Forest of Life
Make the soup in the Soup Kettle

In the Forest of Life go down to the **lowest floor** and go to the far end to the **southeast**, where the {item:Soup Kettle} is. Use on it, one by one, the 20 {item:Carnisylvan Finger|Carnisylvan Fingers}, the 10 {item:Carnisylvan Bark|Carnisylvan Barks} and the 2 {item:Human Teeth}. Then use the Kettle itself.
The Soup Kettle at the bottom of the Forest of Life
Soup ready after using the ingredients and the Kettle
The forest has {creature:Hulking Carnisylvan|Hulking Carnisylvans}, {creature:Dark Carnisylvan|Dark Carnisylvans} and {creature:Poisonous Carnisylvan|Poisonous Carnisylvans}.

From the Kettle go to the large room next to it and use {spell:Levitate} to go up the ramp. Head **south** and walk along the trees (the Sleeping Carnisylvan): you are teleported to a small room where {creature:Megasylvan Yselda} is. You can enter with a team of **up to 5 players**.

There are two possible endings. In the **simple method** you kill Yselda and let at least one of the four **Megasylvan Saplings** die (there is one in each corner of the room): you receive the base outfit, but not the 1st addon. In the **healing method** you keep all four Saplings alive throughout the fight: you also receive the {item:Violet Tulip} and the right to the 1st addon.
Kill Yselda; the Saplings may die
Keep healing the 4 Saplings until Yselda dies
Preparing the team to save the Saplings

For the 1st addon go with a full team of **5**, with as many mages as possible. Each player should bring at least **100** {item:Ultimate Healing Rune|Ultimate Healing Runes}; a druid can also heal them with {spell:Mass Healing}. Agree beforehand who heals: the best healers (mages) stay on the **south** Saplings, the others alternate between attacking Yselda and healing the **north** Saplings.
Everyone should attack Yselda a few times to get participation and loot.
At first Yselda cannot be hurt. Say the words {key:DEMIHBOULDR}, {key:SOMMBHA} and {key:WITHER} in the **NPC Chat** or the **Local Chat** to lower her defences.
These are the ritual words: type them exactly like this.

Yselda has **32,000** hit points, gives **19,900** experience, **does not move**, attacks in melee and summons {creature:Carnisylvan Sapling|Carnisylvan Saplings}. According to the wiki (some values still unconfirmed), she takes full damage (100%) from **holy** and **drown** and very little from the rest: only 40% from fire, 30% from death, 20% from energy, 15% from physical and 10% from ice and earth. In the healing method, the Saplings take around **1000 damage** constantly for almost the whole fight: heal them non-stop until she dies.
If a Sapling dies, you can no longer get the 1st addon or the Violet Tulip in this attempt.

According to the wiki, a team with a lot of damage can kill her so fast that the Saplings' starting health is enough for them to survive without healing. Yselda has a **20-hour** cooldown: if you fail the Saplings, you can try again the next day.

After the fight say {key:hi} to {npc:Yselda}, now in NPC form. The dialogue changes depending on the method: if you saved the Saplings she thanks you for saving her "children". You receive the achievement **Woodcarver**.
Leaving the room and the Forest of Life

Leave Yselda's room through the somewhat hidden teleport to the **south**. From now on you have a shortcut between the Forest of Life and the surface of Bounac, **1 floor above** the room's exit: use it to return to Bounac (and later to go back down without passing through the Bounacean Lion).
4. Receiving the base outfit and the 1st addon

During the day, go back to the throne room and say {key:hi} and {key:yselda} to {npc:Kesar the Younger}. He makes you a royal advisor and gives you the {wiki:Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits|Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits}. If you saved the Saplings, he also gives you a {item:Violet Tulip} (he asks you to take it to Yselda) and tells you to talk to John, the carpenter.
Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfit base (+ Violet Tulip if you saved the Saplings)
Optional: delivering the Violet Tulip to Yselda

Only if you saved the four Saplings: Kesar asks you to take the {item:Violet Tulip} to Yselda. Return to the Forest of Life through the shortcut between the surface and the forest (the forest end is at {coord:32528,32489,11}) and go to {npc:Yselda}, now in NPC form (the map shows where she is; if needed, enter again through the Sleeping Carnisylvan, {coord:32581,32483,12}). Use the tulip next to her: you receive the achievement **Bounacean Chivalry** (2 points, secret). To leave, return to Bounac by the same shortcut.

Only if you saved the four Saplings: wait for **night** (hh:45 to hh:15, real time) and go to the house of {npc:John (Bounac)}, **4 floors above** ground. Say {key:hi} and {key:yselda}. He gives you the **1st addon**.
During the day John is not at home: he appears elsewhere as John the Carpenter.
1st addon of the Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits
5. 2nd addon: The Order of the Stag — the Etzel family writ
The 2nd addon is only earned at the end of {wiki:The Order of the Stag Quest|The Order of the Stag Quest}. Kesar sent his knights to the Isle of Ada and has had no news of them.

During the day, say {key:hi} and {key:help} to {npc:Kesar the Younger}. He asks you to fetch an Etzel family writ kept in a chest, in a sealed room **beneath the cathedral** of Bounac. You have to enter from the holy rooms right above it.
Opening the hole in the cathedral
Go to Bounac's **cathedral** (3 floors above ground). Place the {item:Frozen Starlight} on the stand to open the hole and go down into the sealed room.
Also bring a {item:Pick} (or an equivalent tool): the spoiler lists it as a requirement for the Order of the Stag, without saying exactly where you use it.
Taking the writ from the frozen chest
Down there, open the **frozen chest** and take the Etzel family writ. The wiki does not describe the way out of this room: go back up through the same hole to the cathedral.
Delivering the writ and accepting the voyage

Take the writ to {npc:Kesar the Younger} (during the day) and say {key:hi} and {key:help}. He asks you to show it to **Captain Banner**, leader of the expedition on the Isle of Ada, and explains that there is a boat to the **south**, next to the old fisherman's hut. Answer {key:yes}.
6. Isle of Ada: from the mines to the castle
The Isle of Ada is confusing: it has lots of stairs, doors and Levitate spots, and it is full of monsters. At night the Night Harpy raids make it even more crowded.
Travelling to the Isle of Ada

Leave the castle by the lift (floor below the throne room, ramp to the **south**) and go to the coast **south** of Bounac castle, next to the old fisherman's hut. Use the **rope** inside a small fishing boat: you are taken to the Isle of Ada, where the Bounac expedition's camp is.
Talking to Second In Command Demeron

At the camp where you arrive, say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:tell}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} to {npc:Second In Command Demeron}. He gives you permission to enter the **mines to the north-west**.
Enter the mines and explore them until you reach the marked spot: your quest log is updated.
Spot in the mines that updates the quest log
Optional: Lieutenant Harlan (Supplies for the Steadfast)

On your first visit, crossing the mines you reach the first camp. Say {key:hi}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}, {key:no} to {npc:Lieutenant Harlan}: he opens a path to the **north-east**. If you offer to help, he asks you for 20 {item:Tender Venison} for the camp and gives you **10,000 experience**.
The {creature:Stag|Stags} of the Isle of Ada drop {item:Tender Venison} frequently.
Climbing up to the castle gates

Go back to the mine entrance: now you can use the stairs. Go up the stairs at the first spot, use {spell:Levitate} to go up at the second, go up the stairs at the third and continue to the castle **gates**. If they are open, go in.
Use {spell:Levitate} to **go down twice** at the first two spots, go up the stairs at the third and again at the fourth, and enter the NPC area through the door at the last spot.

If you cannot open those doors yet, or if you want to open the gates: **south** of the gates use {spell:Levitate} to go down; then go up **three times** with Levitate at the following spots, go down once with Levitate and go up the stairs. There you find **two chain mechanisms** that lock the gate: use both **almost at the same time**.
Levitate down, south of the gates
Levitate down, then go up the stairs
A fast player can do it alone; at lower levels a second person may be needed to use the other mechanism.
Inside the castle, go to {npc:Guard Captain Hartford}.

Say {key:hi}, {key:business}, {key:explain}, {key:yes} to {npc:Guard Captain Hartford}. He asks you for **20** {item:Night Harpy Beak|Night Harpy Beaks} as proof that you helped against the harpies, and in return gives you access to the upper hall, where Eldoran is.

{creature:Night Harpy|Night Harpies} only appear **at night**, in a raid that **does not happen every night**; when it starts, it lasts several hours (always only at night). Kill them and use the {item:Obsidian Knife} on the corpses: there is a chance of getting a beak. Repeat until you have **20 beaks**.
Buying beaks on the Market or from other players **does not count**: each character must skin their own.

Night Harpies (14,000 health, 21,000 experience) take more damage from ice (112%), death and holy (109%) and less from fire (70%) and earth (60%). According to Hartford, their nest is in the mountains, far to the south of the island.
Go back to {npc:Guard Captain Hartford} and say {key:hi}, {key:news}, {key:yes}. You gain access to the floor above, where {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious} is. The beaks are **not** taken from you.
Go up the stairs at the first two spots. The door to Eldoran is **hidden behind a tapestry**: use a weapon on the tapestry to break it and go through the door.
Say {key:hi}, {key:word}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} to {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious}. He asks you to clear some corpses in the castle.
There are **three corpses** on the marked floor, next to burning piles. They stand out from the other bodies because they face **right** (the normal ones face west). Use each of them.
Go back to {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious} and say {key:hi}, {key:news}, {key:yes}.
The final part of the Order of the Stag. The {creature:Court Warlock} is an Archfoe boss with 120,000 health that gives 147,000 experience.
Say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious}. He asks you to put an end to the {creature:Court Warlock}.
Crossing the Blood Gorge to the west tower
Go down a few floors to the **Tamed Frazzlemaws** cellar: now you have access to the doors. Cross the **Blood Gorge** and go up to the **west tower** at the marked spot.
Way up to the west tower
In the tower, say {key:hi} and {key:wall} to {npc:Captain Marie-Denise Banner}. She gives you access to the teleport: use the marked **wall** and you are taken to the fight's lever room.
Teleport wall to the lever room
The **first player to enter** the lever room will have Raubritters spawning continuously at their position throughout the fight. Have the **Knight** enter first.
If you go alone, all the Raubritters will spawn on top of you: the wiki recommends level 600+ to do this solo.

The fight starts with continuous waves of Raubritters, each immune to one element. Kill them non-stop. If your area damage is not enough, focus on one target at a time so that you **never have four of the same type alive**: if that happens, they turn into a stronger version that hits much harder.
Attacks from range and runs away from the Knight

Every now and then **all players are teleported** around the room. There is "special" ground, which looks different from the normal floor: **do not step** on it, each step deals heavy **death** damage.
{spell:Chivalrous Challenge} does not work in boss rooms, so the {creature:Energised Raubritter|Energised Raubritters} stay away from the Knight: the ranged attackers should deal with them.
Phase 2: Falcon Paladins and Falcon Knights

After a few waves the room fills with {creature:Falcon Paladin|Falcon Paladins} and {creature:Falcon Knight|Falcon Knights}, and all the special ground disappears: you can now move freely. Kill all the minions.
When all the minions are dead, the {creature:Court Warlock} spawns. The better the fight has gone up to that point, the **less health** it spawns with. Finish it off.

The Court Warlock's cooldown can be reset with a {item:Twisted Marionette}, which it can drop itself. It can also (very rarely) drop pieces of Stag equipment, such as {item:Stag Plate}, {item:Stag Helmet} or {item:Stag Shield}.

The wiki does not describe the way out of the boss room. If after the fight you cannot find an exit teleport, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (wait for the Logout Block to wear off) and return to Eldoran the normal way: boat from Edron to Bounac, fishing boat south of the castle, mines and climb up to the gates (section 6) and stairs to Eldoran's floor (section 8).

Go back to {npc:Eldoran the Ambitious} and say {key:hi} and {key:news}. You receive {item:The Broken Sword of Eldoran Etzel} and the achievement **Bastard**: the Order of the Stag Quest is complete. The quest page also lists the {item:Brass-Shod Chest (Order of the Stag)} as a reward, without saying exactly when you receive it.
The Broken Sword of Eldoran Etzel, Brass-Shod Chest (Order of the Stag) and achievement Bastard

The wiki does not describe the return trip from the Isle of Ada to Bounac. First look for the boat you arrived on, next to the camp of {npc:Second In Command Demeron}. If there is no return trip, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}: it takes you to your town's temple (it does not work in No-Logout Zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). Then return to Bounac by the small boat from Edron (section 1).

During the day, go up to Bounac's throne room and say {key:hi} and {key:help} to {npc:Kesar the Younger}. He gives you the **2nd addon** of the Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits. If you also already have the 1st addon, you receive the achievement **King's Council** (2 points).
2nd addon + achievement King's Council (with both addons)
The achievement **King's Council** was released in the Summer Update 2021, but it only became obtainable with the Winter Update 2025, when the Order of the Stag brought the 2nd addon.
After the Lost Queen you can trade with {npc:John (Bounac)} by saying {key:fragments} (he sells Folded Artefact Carpets).

Optional Order of the Stag mission, *Emmanuelle's Boat Repair*: {npc:Second In Command Demeron} asks for 30 {item:Salvaged Iron Parts}, 20 {item:Salvaged Bronze Parts} and 10 {item:Salvaged Silver Parts} and gives you {item:The Mariner's Compass From the Antoinette}.
Full guide to the missions this outfit depends on: {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest|Adventures of Galthen Quest} and {wiki:The Order of the Stag Quest|The Order of the Stag Quest}.
